verses.text: \s1 Uz ram vah Job hoi a imthung
Uz ram dawk tami buet touh ao teh, a min teh Job doeh. Ahni teh toun hane awm hoeh, tamikalan, Cathut ka taket e, kahawihoehe lamthung ka roun e lah ao.
Capa 7 touh hoi canu 3 touh a tawn.
A tawn e naw teh, tu 7,000, kalauk 3,000, maitotan 500, lamanu 500, hoi a sannaw moikapap a tawn. Ahni teh Kanîtholae taminaw pueng hlak tami ka lentoe poung e lah ao.
A capanaw ni kum tangkuem amamae a khenae pawi a sak awh navah, amamae im dawk bu canae pawi a sak awh teh a kamkhueng awh navah, a tawncanunaw ka 3, touh hai canei hanelah ouk a coun.

Hottelah bu canae pawi abaw hnukkhu vah, Job ni a kaw awh teh, ouk a kamkhueng sak awh. Amom a thaw teh ahnimae milu kuep lah hmaisawi thuengnae sathei ouk a poe. Bangkongtetpawiteh Job ni ka capanaw ni yonnae sak awh vaiteh, a lungthin hoi Cathut hah pahnawt awh langvaih telah ati. Hottelah, Job ni pou a sak.   
\s1 Setan ni Job hringnae a taran
Cathut e capanaw BAWIPA e hmalah tâconae hnin a pha torei teh, Setan hai ahnimouh koe a tho van.
BAWIPA ni Setan koe nâ lahoi maw na tho atipouh. Setan ni BAWIPA talai van ka kâhei teh ka kumluennae koehoi, atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Setan koe ka san Job he na pouk boimaw. Talai van dawk ahni patetlae toun han kaawm hoeh e, tamikalan Cathut ka taket e hoi, kahawihoehe lamthung ka roun e awm hoeh, telah atipouh.
Setan ni BAWIPA a pathungnae teh, Job ni Cathut hah a khuekhaw awm laipalah maw a taki.
Ahni teh a imthung hoi, a tawn e naw pueng hoi, a tengpam pueng pet na kalup teh, a kut hoi a tawk e naw pueng hah yawhawi na poe teh, na kamphung sak nahoehmaw.
Atuvah na kut pho nateh a tawn e hnonaw pueng hah tek pouh haw, na hmaitung roeroe vah nama tang na pahnawt han doeh atipouh.
BAWIPA ni, Setan koe, khenhaw! a tawn e naw pueng teh, nange na kut dawk ao. Ama teh tek hanh atipouh. Hahoi Setan teh BAWIPA koehoi a tâco.
Hnin touh hnin teh, a canu hoi a capanaw teh, a hmau kacue im dawkvah a ca awh teh misurtui a nei awh lahun nah,
Job koe patoune buet touh a yawng teh, maitotannaw talai a kanawk awh lahun nah, lanaw hai ateng a pâ awh lahun navah,
Sheba taminaw ni na tuk awh teh, koung a la awh toe na sannaw hah tahloi hoi a thei awh teh, kai buet touh dueng doeh, nang koe dei hanelah ka hlout atipouh.

A dei lahun nah tami alouke bout a tho. Kalvan hoi Cathut e hmai a bo teh, tu hoi na sannaw hah koung a kak teh be a kahma toe. Kai buet touh dueng doeh nang koe dei hanelah ka hlout e lah ka o atipouh.

A dei lahun nah tami alouke bout a tho. Khaldean taminaw ahu kathum touh lah ao awh teh, kalauknaw hah koung na lawp awh, na sannaw hai tahloi hoi be a thei awh. Kai buet touh dueng doeh nang koe dei hanelah ka hlout atipouh.
A dei lahun nah tami alouke bout a tho. Na canu hoi na capanaw ni, a hmau kacuepoung e im vah a ca awh teh misurtui a nei awh lahun navah,
Khenhaw! kahrawng lahoi kahlî katang poung e a tho teh, imnaw hah a hmang teh, thoundoun, tanglanaw hah koung a ratet teh koung a due. Kai buet touh dueng doeh nang koe dei hanelah ka hlout atipouh.
Hahoi Job ni a thaw teh, ahni a ravei, a lû luengpalueng lah a ngaw teh, talai dawk a tabo teh a bawk.
Anu e von thung hoi tak caici lah ka tâco teh, tak caici lah bout ka ban han. BAWIPA ni na poe teh BAWIPA ni bout a la. BAWIPA min teh pholennae awm seh telah a ti.
Hetnaw dawkvah Job ni yonnae sak laipalah Cathut yonpennae tawn hoeh.
Cathut e capanaw BAWIPA e hmalah a tâconae hnin bout a pha toteh, Setan hai BAWIPA e hmalah kamnue van hanlah ahnimouh koe a tho van.
BAWIPA ni Setan teh nâ lahoi maw na tho atipouh. Setan ni BAWIPA a pathungnae teh, talai van ka kâhei teh, ka kumluennae koehoi, atipouh.

BAWIPA ni Setan koevah, ka san Job heh na pouk boimaw. Ahni patetlae toun han kaawm hoeh e, tamikalan, Cathut ka taket e hoi, kahawihoehe lamthung ka roun e, apihai awm hoeh. Bang hoeh e dawk na ka raphoe nakunghai ama min la doeh poe awm ti atipouh.
Setan ni BAWIPA hah a pathung teh, vuen hanlah vuen lah doeh ao, tami ni a tawnta e pueng hah a hring nahanelah a kâpasoung yawkaw han.
Hateiteh, atu na kut pho nateh, a hru hoi atak tek pouh haw, na hmaitung vah na pahnawt han doeh atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Setan koe, khenhaw! ahni teh na kut dawk ao. Hateiteh a hringnae hah pâhlung atipouh.
Setan teh BAWIPA e hmaitung hoi a tâco teh, Job hah a khok koehoi a lû totouh, ka patawpoung e moihna hoi a kawi sak.
A kâkoe nahanelah Job ni ampaikei hah a la teh hraba dawk a tahung.
A yu ni, na lannae hah pou na kuet han rah maw. Na Cathut hah thoebo nateh, dout lawih atipouh.

Hateiteh ahni ni napui koe, ka pathu e napui ni lawk a dei e patetlah na dei. Bangtelamaw Cathut koehoi hawinae ka hmu katang teh, thoenae hai hmawt mahoeh maw, telah atipouh. Hete hno pueng dawk Job ni apâhni dawk hoi yonnae dei hoeh.   
\s1 Job hoi a huinaw kathum

Job e a hui kathum touh ni, het patet e hawihoehnae ni a pha sin e a thai awh torei teh, amamouh aonae koehoi lengkaleng a tho awh. Teman tami Eliphaz Shuhi tami Bildad hoi, Naamath tami Zophar, bangkongtetpawiteh, ahni lungpahawi hane, lungmawng sak hanelah a kamkhueng awh teh a kâpan awh.
Ahnimouh ni ahlanae koehoi Job hah a khet awh navah, nout thai awh hoeh. Kacaipounglah a ka awh teh, khohnanaw hah vekvek a ravei awh teh, a lûnaw dawk vaiphu a kâphuen awh.
Hottelah hnin sari touh hoi rum sari touh thung talai dawk a tahungkhai awh teh, apinihai ahni koe lawk kam touh hai dei awh hoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, a lungmathoe poung tie hah a panue awh.

\s1 Job ni a khenae hnin thoe a bo  
\q1

Hathnukkhu, Job ni a pahni dawk hoi a khenae hnin hah thoe a bo.   
\q1

Job ni ati e teh,   
\q1

ka khenae hnin hah kahmat pawiteh,  
\q2 capa a vawn ati e tangmin hai kahmat pawiteh,   
\q1

Hatnae hnin hah hmonae lah awm pawiteh,  
\q2 Cathut ni lathueng lahoi khen hanh naseh.  
\q2 Hoehpawiteh, angnae ang hanh naseh.   
\q1

Hmonae hoi duenae tâhlip ni ramuk naseh,  
\q2 tâmai ni ramuk e, kanîthun e hmonae ni pakhi naseh.   
\q1

Hatnae tangmin hah hmonae ni kuen naseh,  
\q2 hatnae kum dawk e hninnaw dawkvah lunghawi van hanh naseh.  
\q2 Thapa touknae dawk hai bawk hanh naseh.   
\q1

Oe, hatnae tangmin hah kingkadi e tangmin lah awm pawiteh,  
\q2 lunghawinae kamthang pai hanh naseh.   
\q1

Tuitam thaw sak hane coungkacoe kaawmnaw ni, hatnae hnin hah,  
\q2 thoekâbonaw ni thoebo awh naseh.   
\q1

Hatnae tangmin amom lae âsi hah mawm naseh,  
\q2 angnae hah tawng awh naseh. Hateiteh, hmawt awh hanh naseh.  
\q2 Kanî a tâco e hai, hmawt hanh naseh.   
\q1

Bangkongtetpawiteh, anu e thun hah khan hoeh eiteh,  
\q2 ka mithmu vah, ka lungmathoenae hah kâhrawk hoeh.   
\q1

Bangkongmaw ka tâco tahma vah, ka due hoeh va.  
\q2 Bangkongmaw von dawk hoi ka tâco nah, kahmakata hoeh va.   
\q1

Bangkongmaw phai dawk tawm e lah ka o,  
\q2 bangkongmaw ka nei hane sanutui na pânei.   
\q1

Bangkongtetpawiteh, ka i vaiteh, karoumcalah ka o han ei,  
\q2 mat ka i vaiteh, ka kâhat hane boum.   
\q1

Talai siangpahrang hoi khokhangkungnaw,  
\q2 ka rawk e bout ka kangdout sakkungnaw hoi vah,   
\q1

hoehpawiteh, sui ka tawn e tami ka lentoe e,  
\q2 a im dawk ngun hoi kakawi sak naw hoi vah,   
\q1

hoehpawiteh, thakoup hoehnahlan ka khe e camo,  
\q2 angnae kahmawt boihoeh e, camo patetlah, kapawk e lah ka o hoeh va.   
\q1

Hawvah tamikathoutnaw ni, runae a sak e hah a kâhat awh teh,  
\q2 hawvah thakatawnnaw hah a kâhat awh.   
\q1

Hawvah thongkabawt e cungtalah a kâhat awh teh,  
\q2 repcoungroe pawlawk hai thai hoeh toe.   
\q1

Hawvah tami kathoung kalen naw cungtalah ao awh teh,  
\q2 a sannaw hah a bawi koehoi a hlout.   
\q1

Bangkongmaw runae ka khang e koevah, angnae poe e lah ao teh,  
\q2 bangdawkmaw a lung ka mathout e koe hringnae hah poe e lah ao.   
\q1

Due han a ngai poung, hateiteh, tho hoeh.  
\q2 Pakawp e râw hlak vah, hoe ka pataw e ka tawng e,   
\q1

phuen a hmu awh navah,  
\q2 dei thai hoeh e a lung kahawi katang e koevah,   
\q1

bangdawkmaw a lamthung hro lah kaawm e koevah,  
\q2 angnae hah poe e lah ao. Cathut ni rapan hoi kalupsin e koevah,   
\q1

Bangkongtetpawiteh, rawca yueng lah ka cingou teh  
\q2 ka khuikanae mitphi hai tui ka lawng e palang patetlah doeh ao.   
\q1

Bangkongtetpawiteh, ka takipoung e hah,  
\q2 ka tak dawk a pha teh, ka ngaihri poung e ni na thosin.   
\q1

Ka phunep hoeh dawk duem kaawm thai hoeh.  
\q2 Kâhat panuek hoeh, bangkongtetpawiteh, rucatnae ni a pha telah ati.

Hahoi Teman tami Eliphaz ni ahni koe bout a dei e teh,   
\b  
\q1

nang koe lawk kam touh ka dei haw vai, na thaima han vaimoe.  
\q2 Hatei apinimaw dei laipalah ao thai han.   
\q1

Tami moikapap na cangkhai toe.  
\q2 Kut tha kaawm hoeh e tha na o sak.   
\q1

Na lawk ni karawmnaw hah a thaw sak teh,  
\q2 khokpakhu tha kaawm hoeh e tha ao sak.   
\q1

Hateiteh, atu nama koe a pha teh,  
\q2 na lung sut a pout.  
\q2 Na tek teh, na ngaihmang.   
\q1

Na barilawa e hoi na kâuepkhai e nahoehmaw,  
\q2 kakuep e lamthung hah na ngaihawi e nahoehmaw.   
\q1

Atu pouk haw, kayonhoehe apimaw kahmakata boi vai.  
\q2 Hat hoehpawiteh, tamikalan hah nâmaw tâkhawng e lah ao boi.   
\q1

Kahmanae dawkvah payonpakainae,  
\q2 talai kanawk teh runae ka tu e ni doeh ouk a a.   
\q1

Cathut e kâha dawk a kahma awh teh,  
\q2 a lungkhueknae kâha dawk be a kak awh.   
\q1

Sendek huk e pawlawk hoi,  
\q2 ka matheng poung e sendektan kanaw e a hâ hah a kâkhoe.   
\q1

Ca hane ao hoeh dawkvah Sendek matawngnaw a kamlum teh,  
\q2 Sendek manu e a canaw teh koung kâkapek awh.   
\q1

Atu arulahoi kai koe lawk a pha teh,  
\q2 ka hnâ ni arulahoi pouk e hah a thai.   
\q1

Karoumcalah a i awh lahun navah,  
\q2 karum vah vision hah pouk lahun navah,   
\q1

Takinae hoi pâyawnae kai koe a pha.  
\q2 Ka hrunaw pueng koung kâhlehlawk sak e han,   
\q1

Hottelah muitha teh,  
\q2 ka hmalah a kâhlai teh,  
\q2 ka muen rueng a thaw.   
\q1

Hote muitha hah a kangdue teh, ka kamnuek e hah kapek thai hoeh.  
\q2 Ka mithmu vah hno buet touh a kamnue, duem ao teh lawk hah ka thai.   
\q1

Ka dout thai e tami heh, Cathut hlak vah a lan thai maw,  
\q2 tami heh kasakkung hlak vah a thoung thai na maw.   
\q1

A sannaw patenghai kâuepkhai hoeh niteh, kalvantaminaw hai na payon tet pouh pawiteh,   
\q1

amhru im dawk kho ka sak niteh, a kungpui teh,  
\q2 vaiphu lah ao teh, ahnimanaw teh, khakbara ni patenghai a tâ thai e hah  
\q2 bangtelamaw hoe a yuem thai han.   
\q1

Amon hoi tangmin totouh katipcalah a kâbawng teh,  
\q2 apinihai tek laipalah a yungyoe a kahma awh.   
\q1

Ahawi poungnae naw hai koung takhoe lah ao teh,  
\q2 lungangnae awm laipalah be a due awh telah atipouh.

Atu kaw haw, na ka pato hane ao awh han vaimoe.  
\q2 Kathounge tami, nâ lah maw na kamlang han.   
\q1

Bangkongtetpawiteh, lungkhueknae ni tamipathu a thei teh,  
\q2 utsinnae ni kamawngrame a thei.   
\q1

Tami ni khawngyang a pabo e hah ka hmu,  
\q2 hateiteh kho a saknae hmuen hah thoe tangka bo.   
\q1

A capanaw teh, a hlout nahane awm hoeh,  
\q2 longkha koe a rawp awh vaiteh, a katin awh han.  
\q2 Ka rungngang hane awm hoeh.   
\q1

Bangkongtetpawiteh, a von ka hlam e ni a a e cang hah be a ca pouh teh,  
\q2 pâkhingum e patenghai hnopainaw hah a lawp awh.   
\q1

Bangkongtetpawiteh, khangnae teh talai dawk hoi ka tho e nahoeh.  
\q2 Rucatnae hai talai dawk hoi ka tho e na hoeh.   
\q1

Hmaitali kahlun lah a luen e patetlah,  
\q2 tami teh rucat hane doeh a khe.   
\q1

Hateiteh, kai niteh, Cathut ka tawng vaiteh,  
\q2 ka rucatnae teh Cathut e hmalah ka dei pouh han.   
\q1

A bawilennae hoi dei thai hoeh e, touk thai hoeh e,  
\q2 kângairunae kasakthaie koe vah.   
\q1

Talai dawk kho a rak sak teh,  
\q2 law dawk tui a lawng sak.   
\q1

Kangduenae hmuen ka rahnoum e hah, a rasang sak teh,  
\q2 lung kamathoutnaw hah, roumnae hmuen dawk a luen sak.   
\q1

Huenghai kaawmnaw khokhangnae hah a kahma sak teh,  
\q2 a kut hoi a noe e naw koung a raphoe pouh.   
\q1

Tami lungkaang huenghai kaawm e hah,  
\q2 a thoumthainae ni a man awh teh, huenghai kaawm naw e khokhangnae hah,  
\q2 amamouh dawk tang a pha han.   
\q1

Kanîthun angnae dawk hmonae hoi a kâhmo awh teh,  
\q2 kanî tuengtalueng thun nah tangmin e patetlah thupthup a payam awh.   
\q1

Hateiteh, tahloi hoi tami ka voutthoup e hah a rungngang teh,  
\q2 athakaawme taminaw e apâhni hoi a kut ni a rungngang awh.   
\q1

Ka roedengnaw ni ngaihawinae a tawn awh teh,  
\q2 lanhoehnae ni a pahni a cakuep pouh.   
\q1

Khenhaw! Cathut ni a toun e tami teh, tami a lung kahawi e doeh.  
\q2 Hatdawkvah Athakasaipounge ni phepnae teh, noutna laipalah awm hanh.   
\q1

Bangkongtetpawiteh, ama ni a hem teh, a hmâ hah ama ni a kawm pouh.  
\q2 Ama ni a hmâ a ca sak teh, a kut hoi a dam sak.   
\q1

Ama ni runae taruk touh dawk hoi a tâco sak e dueng khout laipalah,  
\q2 sari touh thung dawk hoi hai kahawihoehe ni tek awh mahoeh.   
\q1

Ama ni takang duenae thung hoi a ratang awh vaiteh,  
\q2 taran um e tahloi thaonae thung hoi a ratang awh han.   
\q1

Lawkthoeumkha thung hoi hro lah na o vaiteh,  
\q2 rawkphainae a pha torei teh, na taket mahoeh.   
\q1

Rawkphainae hoi takangnae na panui sin vaiteh,  
\q2 talai e sarangnaw hah na taket mahoeh.   
\q1

Bangkongtetpawiteh, kahrawng e talungnaw hoi rei kambawng vaiteh,  
\q2 kahrawng e sarangmathengnaw hoi karoumcalah na o awh han.   
\q1

Na onae rim dawk karoumcalah na o e hah na panue han.  
\q2 Na khosaknae hah na khet navah voutthoupnae banghai awm mahoeh.   
\q1

Na ca catoun moiapap hane hah a panue vaiteh,  
\q2 nange na miphunnaw talai dawk phovai patetlah ao e hah na hmu han.   
\q1

Atueng pha toteh cabong taoung e patetlah na kumcue toteh,  
\q2 phuen koe na pha han.   
\q1

Khenhaw! heteheh ka pakhingpalang awh teh, kalan e doeh ka tho.  
\q2 Thaihaw, nama hane doeh tie hah panuek, telah atipouh.

\s1 Job ni Eliphaz a pathung  
\q1

Oe, ka kângairunae heh, yawcu dawk khing haw pawiteh,  
\q2 ka khang e runae naw hai, yawcu khingnae dawk phat naseh.   
\q1

Bangkongtetpawiteh, palang teng e sadi hlak hai a ri han doeh.  
\q2 Hatdawkvah ka dei payon toe.   
\q1

Bangkongtetpawiteh, Athakasaipounge ni a ka e pala teh kai thung vah ao,  
\q2 ahnimae a sue hah ka muitha ni a nei.  
\q2 Cathut takinae hah ka hmalah a kamnue.   
\q1

Kahrawng e la ni hram a papnae koe a hram boimaw,   
\q1

Atuinae kaawm hoeh e bu teh palawi laipalah ca thai han maw.  
\q2 Aduirakei ka pangaw e dawk atuinae bangmaw kaawm.   
\q1

Ka hringnae ni, a tek han a ngai hoeh e,  
\q2 kai hanelah, panuettho e rawcanaw doeh.   
\q1

Oe, kahei e heh ka hmawt haw pawiteh,  
\q2 Cathut ni ngai poung e na poe haw pawiteh.   
\q1

Pahren lahoi Cathut ni vek na khei haw na seh,  
\q2 A kut na pho sin nateh vitkatip lah, na tâtueng haw naseh,   
\q1

Hottelah nakunghai, ka lungmawngnae ka tawn rah.  
\q2 Patawnae ni na tha hoeh nakunghai ka lunghawi han rah.  
\q2 Bangkongtetpawiteh, tami kathounge lawk hah kâhrawk mahoeh.   
\q1

Bangpatete thaonae maw ka tawn teh, ka ngaihawi han rah.  
\q2 Ka poutnae hah, banglamaw ao teh, ka hringnae ni a saw sak han rae te,   
\q1

Ka thaonae heh lungsong thaonae lah maw ao.  
\q2 Ka takthai he rahum lah maw a tho.   
\q1

Ka thung vah kabawmkung awmhoeh namaw,  
\q2 ka kuepcingnae naw pueng kai koehoi be kampuen toung nahoehmaw.   
\q1

Bangpueng katetthai takinae a ceitakhai nakunghai,  
\q2 patawnae ka khang e koevah, a hui koehoi a lungmanae kamnue sak hane doeh.   
\q1

Ka hmaunawnghanaw teh palang tui patetlah yuengyoe kampuen e doeh,  
\q2 dawngdengca dawk kahmat e palang tui patetlah ao awh.   
\q1

Tui a kamkak e kecu dawkvah a tamang teh,  
\q2 a thungvah ka kâhrawk e tadamtui patetlah ao.   
\q1

Abet torei teh, be kahma awh teh,  
\q2 a kâan torei teh amamae hmuen koehoi kahmakata awh.   
\q1

Amamae a lamthung dawk hoi a kamlang awh teh,  
\q2 nâ lahai cet laipalah kahmakata awh.   
\q1

Teman miphun kahlawng kacetnaw ni a khet awh teh,  
\q2 Sheba kahlawng kacetnaw ni a ngaihawi awh.   
\q1

A ngâhawi awh dawkvah, a lungpout awh.  
\q2 Hawvah a pha awh torei teh, a kaya awh.   
\q1

Bangkongtetpawiteh, atuvah banglahai na tho awh hoeh toe.  
\q2 Takikatho e na hmu awh teh, na lung a puen awh.   
\q1

Na poe awh haw, telah ka dei boimaw, hoeh pawiteh,  
\q2 na hnopainaw dawk hoi, kai na ratang nahanelah poe awh ka ti boimaw,   
\q1

Hoeh pawiteh, ka tarannaw e kut dawk hoi na rungngang awh haw, ka ti boimaw,  
\q2 hoeh pawiteh, kai ka hnephnap e koehoi na ratang awh ka ti boimaw.   
\q1

Na cangkhai awh haw, duem ka o han,  
\q2 lawkkalan hah na panuek sak awh.   
\q1

Lannae teh, banghloimaw a tha ao.  
\q2 Hateiteh, na lawknaw ni bangmaw a kamceng sak.   
\q1

Lawk ka dei e naw heh yonpen hane maw na ngai awh.
